name: DMC - 01: AI Inquiry Intake to Branded Proposal Generator

parameters.text:
=You are an expert DMC (Destination Management Company) Travel Operations Specialist.
Analyze the following travel inquiry / RFP email:

---
{{ $json.body.email_content || $json.body.rfp_text || $json.body.message || JSON.stringify($json.body) }}
---

Extract the travel requirements into a strict JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "client_name": "Full Name or Agency Name",
  "client_email": "Email address",
  "destination": "Primary destination or region",
  "travel_start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "travel_end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "duration_days": 4,
  "pax_adults": 2,
  "pax_children": 0,
  "service_tier": "Standard | Superior | Luxury | Ultra-VIP",
  "interests": ["list", "of", "interests"],
  "special_requests": "dietary, mobility, flight info, etc.",
  "requested_services": [
    {
      "day_number": 1,
      "service_type": "Transfer",
      "title": "Arrival Airport Transfer to Hotel",
      "notes": "Mercedes vehicle required"
    },
    {
      "day_number": 2,
      "service_type": "Excursion",
      "title": "Private Guided Historical Tour",
      "notes": "English speaking certified guide"
    }
  ]
}
Return ONLY valid raw JSON, without markdown code fences.

=🛎️ *New Proposal Ready for Review*
*Ref:* `{{ $json.inquiry_id }}`
*Client:* {{ $json.client_name }}
*Destination:* {{ $json.destination }} ({{ $json.pax_adults }} Pax)
*Dates:* {{ $json.travel_start_date }} to {{ $json.travel_end_date }}
*Selling Price:* {{ $json.currency }} {{ $json.gross_selling_price }} (22% Margin)

⚡ Proposal HTML created and ready for travel designer sign-off.
